name: @nopilot/schema-mcp
description: Local-first MCP server for deterministic JSON Schema work: path-level diff between two schema versions, breaking vs non-breaking change classification (required additions, type narrowing, enum removals, minimum tightening, pattern changes...), same-document $ref tracking, draft-07 & 2020-12 subsets with explicit not_supported reporting, and instance validation. stdio + Streamable HTTP. Zero network, zero LLM.
author: latbert
